summary: The Middleby Corporation filed an 8-K updating the spin-off of its food processing subsidiary, Midera Food Processing, Inc. The distribution of Midera common stock to Middleby shareholders is expected at 12:01 a.m. ET on July 6, 2026. Midera entered a $1.0 billion credit agreement ($750M US revolver, $250M multi-currency revolver) on June 29, 2026, and used borrowings and cash to pay a $233M distribution to Middleby. The transaction does not name an advisor or board recommendation in this filing. Watch for the distribution date and post-spin trading of Midera shares. The risk-arb angle focuses on the separation mechanics and the new credit structure.
